_doc: Authored grip data per weapon mesh (our own values; native mesh space, centimetres, gothic left-handed coordinates before the engine X mirror). Stored values win over the automatic analysis in grip.rs. center = point on the handle that sits in the middle of the fist; blade = direction from the handle out along the blade; edge = direction of the cutting edge (flat normal = blade x edge); curl.grip = finger flexion 0..1 for middle/ring/little and (x0.7) thumb, curl.trigger = index flexion 0..1.
